services.desc: Due to insurance requirements, all crew members must have a pit pass in the trailer area, garage area or anywhere in the pit area during practice or race days. Anyone caught without a pitpass will be asked to leave immediately. Pit passes on practice days are $15.00 per person for anyone over the age of 5.
